hidden_reference_policy: Two of ten QCs per plate; seed = master seed + 3000; hidden IDs relabeled ordinary Sample and excluded from all QC fitting/tuning.
phenotype_blinding: No phenotype, response truth, or confounding labels are passed to any correction method or method cache context.
nominal_one_label: maximal feasible under balanced five-plate design; not complete global confounding
non_estimability: Rank-deficient or aliased phenotype coefficients are NA with explicit not_estimable status; preprocessing is not claimed to solve the design.
primary_effect_reference: clean-matrix log1p estimand and paired zero

portable_reconstruction_hash.equivalence_gate: SHA-256 identity of raw_log_with_biology and clean_log_with_biology after round(x, 9); dimensions and dimnames are included in R serialization
portable_reconstruction_hash.intensity_hash_status: intensity object and intensity round9 hashes are recorded as platform diagnostics and are not reconstruction gates

observed_cross_platform_diagnostic.comparison: all 320 scenarios, macOS arm64 versus R 4.5.1 Linux x86_64 on the Euler Intel login node; failed v2 tasks also sampled AMD EPYC 7763 and EPYC 9654 compute nodes
observed_cross_platform_diagnostic.v2_array_failure_detail: CONF09 all 16 scenarios plus CONF16_run_order_0p90 stopped before method execution at the raw-log round-10 preflight gate
observed_cross_platform_diagnostic.v3_status: round-9 is the narrowest tested decimal gate with complete cross-platform identity; dimensions and dimnames remain hashed

phenotype_aware_combat: not run: unchanged run_combat() wrapper has no phenotype-covariate interface; never mix with phenotype-blind ranking
